H1.title: Unbounded uvicorn drain turns a normal quit into a SIGKILL
H1.resolution: server/desktop_child.py passes timeout_graceful_shutdown=_graceful_timeout_seconds(launch) (half of grace_ms, floor 1s) and the _serve docstring no longer calls an unbounded drain a superset of the contract floor. Trigger corrected: an open SSE stream does NOT hold the drain (sse-starlette closes its own streams on should_exit); any incomplete request cycle does. Measured live: unbounded = no exit at 60s, bounded = exit 0 at 17.9s. Guards: test_graceful_drain_is_bounded_by_the_launch_frame, test_serve_hands_the_bounded_drain_to_uvicorn, and AC4 now wedges an undrainable request across the shutdown.

M1.title: /status and /ui/status-badge leak readiness past the /readyz gate
M1.resolution: Documented, not widened, with evidence: server/frontend/templates/base.html polls /ui/status-badge every 10s from the webview, which holds no capability, so gating it would 401 the shipped desktop console on every page.
